Diagnosis: wrong-time prompt + high-ability-cost action + absent reward (B=MAP triple-miss)
Lever 1: context-triggered prompt over clock-triggered prompt
Lever 2: dictation + AI splitting to cut action cost (יומן היום)
Lever 3: reward reframed as near-term personal relief, not KPI
Lever 4: self-serve gap visibility (פערים שלי) instead of manager nags
Lever 5: idempotent, capped nudges (one nudge, no repeat)
Recommendation: per-person daily push cap across all surfaces (3/day, missing today)
Escalation ladder: escalate audience/format, never tone (self → gentle → owner-aggregated)
Weekly usage narrative (§7j) — highest surveillance-backfire risk feature
Hard rule: no leaderboards, no points/badges/streaks tied to compliance
Hard rule: no real-time individual compliance visibility to עידן/עמיחי
2-week pilot rollout plan (field flow, gaps, day-log) with success thresholds
Target tap-count/time budget per field job (check-in, visit, cert, stock, attendance)
